Privacy Policy
The short version: your puzzles stay on your phone, we have no accounts, and we don't sell or share anything. The rest is detail.
Updated 1 August 2026

✓
What stays on your phone
Your solves, your streak, your nudge balance, which packs you own, and your reminder time are stored only on your device. We never receive them, and we can't see them. If you delete Word Hug, that data goes with it — which also means we can't restore it for you, apart from purchases.
What we do collect
Two things, both optional and neither tied to your identity:
Crash reports. If the app fails, your phone's operating system may send us a technical report. It contains device model and OS version, not your puzzles. You can switch this off in your system settings.
Emails you send us. If you write to us, we keep the thread so we can reply. We delete support threads after twelve months and never add your address to a mailing list.
There are no ads, no analytics SDKs, no advertising identifiers, and no third-party trackers in the app.
Purchases
Hug Packs and nudge coins are sold by Apple and Google, not by us. They handle payment and tell the app what you own; we never see your card details, billing address, or full name. Restoring purchases asks the store, not us. Their privacy policies apply to that part of the transaction.
Notifications
The daily reminder is scheduled locally on your phone at the time you pick. Nothing is sent from a server, so we don't hold a push token or know whether you opened it. Turning reminders off in Settings stops them completely.
Children
Word Hug is suitable for all ages and we don't knowingly collect personal information from anyone, including children. Because there are no accounts and no profiles, there's nothing to collect. Purchases are governed by the parental controls in your app store.
Your rights
Under the UK GDPR and similar laws you can ask what we hold about you, ask for a copy, or ask us to delete it. In practice the only thing we could ever hold is an email thread you started. Write to hello@wordhug.app and we'll deal with it within thirty days. If you're unhappy with our response you can complain to your local data protection authority.
Changes & contact
If this policy changes we'll update the date above and note what changed. Material changes will also be mentioned in the app. Questions to hello@wordhug.app — a real person reads it.
